name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeInput_some
typeText:
∀ (bs : List.{0} Bool) (k : Nat) (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeInput bs) (Option.some.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} k g)) →
    Eq.{1} bs (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.encodeInput k g)

source.code:
/-- **Acceptance**: only canonical encodings parse. -/
theorem decodeInput_some (bs : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (g : GInstance)
    (h : decodeInput bs = some (k, g)) : bs = encodeInput k g := by
  unfold decodeInput at h
  cases hp : decodePair' bs with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; simp at h
  | some p =>
      obtain ⟨⟨k', g'⟩, rest⟩ := p
      rw [hp] at h
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
          simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
          obtain ⟨hk, hg⟩ := h
          subst hk; subst hg
          simpa using decodePair'_some bs k' g' [] hp
      | cons b rest => simp at h
